items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯：巴库周四表现稳健，拉塞尔两节领先
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队总结巴库周四表现，称乔治·拉塞尔的赛车全程运行可靠，两节练习均排名第一，并完成了富有成效的长距离测试。车队表示仍有可改进之处，但对赛车表现感到鼓舞。

media.altZh: 梅赛德斯：巴库周四表现稳健，拉塞尔两节领先

items.originalTitle: 💬 We've had a solid day overall. George's car ran reliably throughout; he topped both sessions and completed a productive long run. There are still...
items.summaryEn:
💬 We've had a solid day overall. George's car ran reliably throughout; he topped both sessions and completed a productive long run. There are still areas we can improve, as is always the case on a Friday, but the car is behaving well, and we're encouraged by what we've seen so far.
Find out what Shov, George and Kimi have to say about a solid Thursday in Baku 👉https://bit.ly/ThursReportTW
detailZh:
💬 总的来说，我们度过了扎实的一天。乔治的赛车全程运行可靠；他在两节练习中都排名第一，并完成了富有成效的长距离测试。和每个周五一样，我们仍有可以改进的地方，但赛车表现良好，我们对目前看到的情况感到鼓舞。
看看Shov、George和Kimi如何评价在巴库扎实的周四 👉https://bit.ly/ThursReportTW
detailEn:
💬 We've had a solid day overall. George's car ran reliably throughout; he topped both sessions and completed a productive long run. There are still areas we can improve, as is always the case on a Friday, but the car is behaving well, and we're encouraged by what we've seen so far.
Find out what Shov, George and Kimi have to say about a solid Thursday in Baku 👉https://bit.ly/ThursReportTW
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔在巴库周四的两节练习中均排名第一。
车队表示仍有可改进之处，但对目前表现感到鼓舞，并附上了Shov、George和Kimi的采访链接。
